Питання: Can an employer dismiss an employee while the employee is on sick leave?

Еталонна відповідь: General rule — no: Article 40 of the Labour Code prohibits dismissal on the employer's initiative during temporary incapacity for work (except paragraph 5 of Article 40 and full liquidation). But during martial law Article 5 of Law No. 2136-IX allows it, with the dismissal date set to the first working day after the sick leave ends. A complete answer names both.

Відповідь системи: No, dismissal at the employer's initiative during an employee's temporary incapacity (sick leave) is not allowed under the Labour Code. [2] The exceptions are dismissals under clauses 5 and 13 of part one of Article 40 and the complete liquidation of the enterprise, institution or organization. [2] ILO Convention No. 158 also says that temporary absence from work due to illness or injury is not a lawful ground for dismissal. [7] This ban applies only to dismissals initiated by the employer. Dismissal at the employee's own request during sick leave is not prohibited by labour law. [3] If the employee has not withdrawn their resignation, they are dismissed on the date stated in the application or after the two-week notice period, even if that date falls during sick leave. [1]
